notes_for_editor: Thin record: the tnlandforms list is the only source that places a tower here. The list's number (860) has no column label; it is read as feet, which matches the record's 262.1 m. Identity is inferred: the list name is hollinville, the community is Hollonville, and the coordinates are close, but no source ties a tower to the community. Two searches found no tower in Hollonville. Other Pike County list points (pike, GA281 at 33.18822,-84.26786; zebulon, GA332 at 33.08805,-84.33278) could be confused with this one. A search summary mentioned a TowerDex Pike County directory with one 60.9 m structure not described as a fire tower; TowerDex refused fetches (403), so it is unread and unused. Status, access, staffing and history all unknown; the story does not guess at them.
